A finance broker helps you compare lender policies, prepare documents and understand borrowing options. Credit advice is provided by a licensed broker or authorised credit representative. Can a broker help with ACT stamp duty concessions? A broker can help you understand what documents a lender may need, but concession eligibility should be checked with the ACT Revenue Office or your conveyancer. Is the ACT Home Buyer Concession Scheme still income tested? ACT Revenue Office guidance says that from 1 July 2026 there is no income threshold for the Home Buyer Concession Scheme. Always check the current page before signing. How much deposit do I need in Canberra? Deposit needs depend on property price, lender policy, savings history and whether a guarantee or concession applies. Many buyers compare 5, 10 and 20 percent pathways.
